From 57da742b13c85b5671be2638d7c9d1d31c5c93bb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sunny Kumar <sunkumar@redhat.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2018 15:07:02 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] cli : fix coverity cli-rl.c

This fixes new coverity issue introduced by commit 5acb74d7da.

Fixes 1395188.

Change-Id: I629e5f214150672e309abb2fc58f55f1f58d8fb7
updates: bz#789278
Signed-off-by: Sunny Kumar <sunkumar@redhat.com>

diff --git a/cli/src/cli-rl.c b/cli/src/cli-rl.c
index 215fbebb99..4ddb2ab149 100644
--- a/cli/src/cli-rl.c
+++ b/cli/src/cli-rl.c
@@ -295,7 +295,7 @@ cli_rl_autocomplete_prepare (struct cli_state *state, const char *text)
         if (!word)
                 goto out;
 
-        if (!tokens)
+        if (!token)
                 return 0;
         matches = cli_rl_get_matches (state, word, token);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `cli/src/cli-rl.c`**
   - The variable check was modified from `if (!tokens)` to `if (!token)`. This change corrects a potential bug by ensuring that the correct variable (`token`) is checked for nullity before proceeding with the function logic.

### Relationships
- The modification in `cli/src/cli-rl.c` addresses a new issue identified by Coverity, which was introduced by a previous commit (5acb74d7da). The change ensures that the function `cli_rl_autocomplete_prepare` correctly verifies the existence of the `token` variable, thereby preventing potential null pointer dereference errors. This fix is linked to the bug report (Fixes 1395188) and is part of ongoing maintenance to improve code quality.
